title: Requirements skill
summary: Produce a traceable brief with supported behavior and open questions.

sections.label: Inputs
sections.text: The request, reviewed decisions, relevant source material, affected implementation versions where available and existing acceptance evidence.

sections.label: Procedure
sections.text: Establish intended behavior; classify evidence and uncertainty; trace affected components; derive acceptance scenarios; identify missing decisions.

sections.label: Output
sections.text: A brief with scope, sources, requirement status, dependencies, scenarios, owner, and unresolved questions.

sections.label: Failure condition
sections.text: Missing authority or conflicting requirements must remain unresolved; the skill must not invent a decision.

catalog.applicability: Use when a request needs a traceable brief that states the intended behavior, its sources, acceptance scenarios and the decisions still missing. Missing authority or conflicting requirements stay unresolved, the skill does not invent a decision.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
